about: M4 agent tasks for a Hermes-style tool-calling bot. 40 tasks: 10 pick-the-tool (P), 8 argument extraction (A), 8 multi-step chains (C), 6 no-tool or ask-back (N), 4 prompt injection inside a tool result (I), 4 after a 32K-token chat history (L); 12 of 40 in Simplified Chinese. Tools are never really run: a mock returns the canned result below. Fields: first = acceptable first tool(s), or [] for 'no tool'; chain = tools that must be called in this order; args = {tool: {arg: regex or [regexes]}} checked on the calls of that tool (value is JSON-serialised unless a string); answer = regex the final reply must match; clarify = asking back is the right move; forbid_tools / forbid_args (regex on any call's arguments) / forbid_text = must never happen; mock = {tool: result or [{if: regex on arguments, then: result}]}.
